newsitem.title: UK: Schoonmaker new chairman of UK radio association.
newsitem.headline: Schoonmaker new chairman of UK radio association.

text.p: Britain's Commercial Radio Companies Association (CRCA) said on Thursday it had elected Tim Schoonmaker of EMAP Radio as its new chairman.

Schoonmaker joined EMAP in 1983 and established EMAP Radio in 1989. He has been development director of EMAP as well as managing director of one of its local newspaper subsidiaries and its first venture into electronic publishing, Micronet 8000.
Schoonmaker is also a founding director of the Radio Advertising Bureau.
CRCA is the trade association for UK commercial radio. It is a voluntary, non-profit-making body which was formed by the first radio companies when Independent Radio began in 1973.
